newsitem.title: USA: Maystadt says hopes Italy will be in EMU at start.
newsitem.headline: Maystadt says hopes Italy will be in EMU at start.

text.p: Belgian Finance Minister Philippe Maystadt said on Tuesday he hoped Italy would be among the first group of countries joining European monetary union when it is launched in 1999.
Maystadt, who is also head of the International Monetary Fund Interim Committee, was speaking to Reuters at the annual meeting of the IMF and World Bank.
"We hope that Italy will join with the first group of countries participating in monetary union," he said.
French President Jacques Chirac had suggested that Italy would not make it into monetary union at the start, provoking a diplomatic row between France and Italy.
Maystadt was speaking in his capacity as Belgian finance minister.
